name: craftsman
description: Make AI coding agents prove they reviewed and tested their change.

interface.shortDescription: Prove the change was reviewed and tested
interface.longDescription: Build freely, review hard. Craftsman freezes the final diff, plans a bug hunt from it, sends fresh-context hunters over every slot, has verifiers try to disprove every finding, and records the outcome and the test runs in a ledger in the .git directory. Codex runs the protocol without hooks, so the review is advisory and the report marks it SELF-REVIEWED. The skills call the craftsman CLI: install it with `pipx install craftsman-gate`.
defaultPrompt: Use $craftsman:craftsman to add pagination to the catalog search
Use $craftsman:craft-review to review my staged changes and fix what you find
Use $craftsman:craft-review to review this branch, be thorough
